title: Refuse merge on a capped cell with no leader check
action: Add a WORKTREE_MERGE_LEADER_CHECK_DEBT refusal arm, copied in shape from the dissent arm at phases.rs:252-271. Place it in the zero-mutation zone — after the dissent arm and before the advisor-nudge arm at :293 — so a leader-check-debt merge is refused, never staged. Guard it with `if let Some(feature) = identity.feature.as_deref()`, the same None posture every door there takes. Call the SAME crate::verbs::cells::feature_leader_check_debt and crate::verbs::cells::has_leader_check_deferral_decision that the close door reads — one obligation, two doors, never a second reading of the rule (the comment at phases.rs:236-238 names that rule). Render ids through crate::verbs::drivers::js_join, as the dissent arm does. The message names bee cells leader-check as the remedy and states that the leader-check-deferral escape is the same one bee close's door reads. This arm ships in the SAME slice as lcd-2 because under the default uat_stop=close (src/uat.rs:44) merge runs BEFORE close — a close-only door lets the branch land on main unchecked.
